concept.description: List Open DependaBot PullRequests per Repository
concept.cypher: MATCH (r:GitHub:Repository) -[:HAS_PULL_REQUEST]->(n:GitHub:PullRequest {state:"OPEN"}) -[:CREATED_BY]->(u:GitHub:User {username:"dependabot[bot]"}) RETURN r.name as Repository, r.uri as URL, n.title as Title, n.number as Id, n.updatedAt as Date // ORDER BY NoofOpenDependabotPRs DESC ORDER BY Repository, Date DESC

constraint.description: No component must directly use Plexus Container
constraint.cypher: MATCH (s:Maven:Project) -[:CREATES]-> (a:Maven:Artifact) -[d:DEPENDS_ON]-> (t {group: 'org.codehaus.plexus', name: 'plexus-container-default'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.groupId AS srcGroup, s.artifactId AS srcArtifact, t.version AS tgtVersion, t.group AS tgtGroup, t.name AS tgtArtifact, d.scope AS depScope
